values.note: Single sites C$50 Sunday-Thursday, C$60 Friday, Saturday and holidays; GST, reservation fees and firewood included. A second unit for adults on a single site costs extra. Tandem and group sites are priced apart.

fees.source: Operator rates page https://www.entwistlervcampground.ca/rates--amenities.html (read 2026-11-10): 'All amenities, reservation fees, and taxes (GST) are included in the rate.', 'WEEKEND RATE (Friday, Saturday, Holidays) $60/night', 'WEEKDAY RATE (Sunday-Thursday) $50.00/night'; Operator FAQ https://www.entwistlervcampground.ca/faq.html (read 2026-11-10): 'If the second unit accommodates adult(s) aged 18 or over, a n additi[onal fee]'

values.note: Online (CampLife) or by phone. The person booking must be 21 or older. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon. Cancellation more than 5 days out C$15; within 5 days, one night.

booking.source: Operator rates page https://www.entwistlervcampground.ca/rates--amenities.html (read 2026-11-10): 'Book online or by calling 780-719-9009'; home page 'Book Now' -> https://www.camplife.com/365/reservation/step1; Operator policies page https://www.entwistlervcampground.ca/policies.html (read 2026-11-10): 'Only those 21 years of age or older will be allowed to book a campsite.', 'Check in time is 2 p.m. and check out time is 12 p.m.', 'Cancellations more than 5 days before scheduled arrival will be subject to a $15 cancellation charge. Cancellations 5 days or less before scheduled arrival will be subject to a charge equivalent to a one night stay.'

facilities.source: Operator rates page https://www.entwistlervcampground.ca/rates--amenities.html (read 2026-11-10): 'Dump Stations', 'Water Stations', 'Flush and Pit Toilets'

hookups.source: Operator rates page https://www.entwistlervcampground.ca/rates--amenities.html (read 2026-11-10): 'Each site has 30 AMP power, water, a picnic table, and a fire pit.'

note: Family-owned campground (Rainbow Beach Developments) beside the Pembina River gorge, within walking distance south of the hamlet of Entwistle: single sites plus a tandem site and 10 group sites, firewood included, gated entrance. The 2023 Parkland County wildfire left many of the single sites and trails with fewer trees; the group sites were untouched. No ATVs. --Claude
summary: Confirmed C$50 weekday / C$60 Fri-Sat-holiday single sites (GST, reservation fee and firewood included), 30 A + water at every site, dump/water stations, flush and pit toilets, CampLife booking, 21+ to book. Wrote fees (weekend/holiday +C$10, tax included), booking (CampLife url, check-in, cancellation), facilities (+potable water), hookups; note tidied. Season left as stored (CampLife says only 'May Long Weekend to September-ish').
flags: PRICE GATE (private): base C$50 Sun-Thu (C$60 Fri/Sat/holidays), GST and fees included - under C$69, passes. No gateway needed.

PRESENCE: operator site answers 200 with phone 780-719-9009 (stored, confirmed on every page and on Google); Google Maps 'Entwistle RV Campground' 4.6 from 84 reviews, phone +1 780-719-9009, 53230 Range Rd 74A. RV Life 4.5 / $$ (stored).

LONG STAY: no weekly, monthly or seasonal rates offered anywhere on the site; nightly rates posted and sold online (CampLife: 41 sites sold online, types 30 Amp Back In / Pull Thru / Tandem / Group). All five tests pass.

SEASON (left derived 05-15 to 09-30): the home page says 'now closed for the 2026 camping season'; CampLife's date message (read 2026-10-14): 'closed for the season on this date. Please check back during our camping season, from May Long Weekend to September-ish!' and 'Reservations for the 2027 camping season are not yet available'. No exact dates published.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): on Esri imagery the site loops lie east of the river road; the Pembina River channel is about 250-300 m west of the nearest loop, with a gravel road and wooded bank between.

PIN (53.58390,-114.99730): on the office/buildings at the centre of the campground, with the site loops within ~150 m to the NW and S; CampLife 53.583966,-114.996469, Google 53.58477,-114.99650. No move.

WEBSITE: both stored URLs - https://www.entwistlervcampground.ca/ answered 200; the stored camplife.com/campground link was not re-fetched (CampLife's WAF refuses plain HTTP); the site's own Book Now goes to https://www.camplife.com/365/reservation/step1 (now booking.url).
